releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.201: Home Screen widget buttons now expand equally to the available widget width. The widget can be resized from the Home Screen, and text, date visibility and padding adapt to the available dimensions. Individual 3D press feedback and all four independent shortcuts are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Removed the temporary Web Update 363 test label from the Me screen. No other Diary feature or APK change.
